##### Project general facts

Honeymoon Island and The Floating Seahorse  is the world's first luxury underwater living experience, a feat of innovation achieved by a marriage of engineering and imagination. Spanning three levels including a spectacular underwater floor, each villa offers a coral garden and indoor, outdoor, and underwater living and entertainment spaces. Honeymoon Island is a charming Maldivian-inspired resort and the exclusive home to the Floating Seahorses, delivering world-class facilities including white sandy beaches, fine dining, infinity-edged lagoon pools, and lush landscapes for an unforgettable romantic retreat.

This five-star destination is connected to the Floating Seahorses and Main Europe island by floating jetties. Guests enjoy a rich calendar of European experiences, private beaches, fine dining, dinner under the stars, water sports activities, exclusive parties, and festivals. State-of-the-art home automation, outdoor climate-control technologies, and a coral garden teeming with marine life create an exceptional environment for both adventure and tranquility. 

Exemplifying the superior craftsmanship of Bentley motor car interiors, the Bentley Edition brings the refinement synonymous with the world's finest car interiors to the Floating Seahorse. Bespoke material choices perfectly match form to function, delivering elegant and sophisticated furniture that offers supreme comfort. Hand-finished pieces embroidered with the Bentley emblem embody the spirit and workmanship of Bentley motor cars. Kitchens are fully furnished, and underwater bathrooms are crafted with the finest marble, offering a sophisticated space and an indulgence for the senses.


##### Location description and benefits

Nestled within The Heart of Europe, a destination of six islands set against the backdrop of The World Islands, Dubai, this exceptional location is visible from outer space as a collection of manmade islands forming a unique map of our planet. Surrounded by the Arabian Gulf, the area attracts a stunning variety of marine life all year round, offering a secluded paradise where privacy, tranquility, and luxury converge.

The location is distinguished by its unparalleled exclusivity and connectivity. Arrival is by boat, seaplane, or helicopter, with a shuttle service running every fifteen minutes for guests from Dubai mainland. The islands provide an elite retreat with panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and access to pristine beaches, while high-end resorts, boutique hotels, and entertainment facilities ensure world-class dining, spa treatments, and water sports are always within reach.

For those seeking a residence that embodies innovation, romance, and the ultimate in luxury living, The Heart of Europe delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of man-made grandeur, natural beauty, and a prestigious Dubai address makes it one of the most desirable destinations in the world. This is a place where one can live exquisitely — serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected to the city that has it all.
